shots.description: Night rain chase: three cruisers on Rico's tail, explosion with shockwave ring, wanted 3 stars, raid danger zone on the minimap, DISPATCH dialogue
Ocean Drive at dusk in the rain — wet roads, glowing street lamps, Rico on foot by the beach, dialogue subtitle
Payback standoff in the plaza — KING's ultimatum as a dialogue subtitle, the Kings in a ring with health bars, bonus objective on screen
The Big Score at night in the rain: five stars, $5,250, four cruisers in formation, explosion ahead, Rico's getaway line
